slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
dangerously confident

the door sentence

when you hold a door for someone, add one real sentence instead of just a nod. ten tiny conversations a week quietly rewire the part of you that thinks strangers are dangerous.

the middle seat

on trains, in cinemas and in classrooms, take a seat in the middle instead of the corner. choosing the visible spot on purpose teaches your body it's allowed to be seen.

walking straight

on busy pavements, stop always being the first to step aside and walk calmly in a straight line. constantly shrinking out of the way is a habit your brain notices, and so do others.

train ride lessons

on your next train or bus ride, spend 5 minutes learning about the city you live in: its history, a building, a famous person from it. knowing your place changes how you walk through it.
slides.texte_sophia:
train ride lessons

on your next train or bus ride, spend 5 minutes on your city: its history, a famous building. a micro-learning app like the Sophia app makes it easy, and you'll walk through your city differently.

slides.texte_overlay:
three good mornings

say good morning to at least 3 people on your way somewhere, every day for a week. it costs nothing, and the world gets surprisingly warm once you're the one who goes first.
